adjudication_basis: SlowMist explicitly identifies this Fantom exploit execution and the depositFor callback flaw. Halborn independently explains the same nested reward-accounting reentry in the December 2021 Grim incident; its analysis cites the protocol, not SlowMist. The second article is incident corroboration, not a second assertion of the exact hash.

independent_observations.mechanism_excerpt: It failed to check the validity of the token passed in by the user and did not have a reentrancy guard.
A function vulnerable to reentrancy does not properly update its internal state before sending a transfer to an external contract.
